name: Tmc2209 → Coolconf
description: Change the CoolStep settings at runtime. CoolStep uses the StallGuard result to lower the motor current when the load is low and raise it again when the load increases. It is active in the same speed range as StallGuard. See the `COOLCONF` register in the datasheet for details.

config_entries.label: Sedn
config_entries.description: How fast the current is lowered, `0` to `3`. `0` lowers the current by one step for every 32 StallGuard measurements, `1` for every 8, `2` for every 2 and `3` for every measurement.

config_entries.label: Seimin
config_entries.description: The minimum current CoolStep lowers to. `false` for half of the run current, `true` for a quarter.

config_entries.label: Semax
config_entries.description: The upper StallGuard threshold for lowering the current, `0` to `15`. The current is lowered when the StallGuard result is at or above (`semin` + `semax` + 1) × 32.

config_entries.label: Semin
config_entries.description: The lower StallGuard threshold for raising the current, `0` to `15`. The current is raised when the StallGuard result drops below `semin` × 32. `0` disables CoolStep, which is the power-up value.

config_entries.label: Seup
config_entries.description: The current increment step size, `0` to `3`, for 1, 2, 4 or 8 current steps.
